clues.title: Plate: Panama features short licence plates
text: Panama features short licence plates, most commonly white with a horizontal **turquoise strip **on the** top**. Rarely, the strip can have [other colours](https://goo.gl/maps/xCKZgTN28Dzp9W8w6).
Front plates are **not **required in Panama.

clues.title: Google car: Panama was covered by a large white pickup truck that is…
text: Panama was covered by a large white pickup truck that is usually **entirely blurred**. An antenna is occasionally visible.

NOTE: The [Costa Rican](https://maps.app.goo.gl/468aLVF3daz21MRLA) truck is usually unblurred. The car used in [Ecuador](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dSweUPGTkgTasq9B7) has neither an antenna nor a white metal railing.

clues.title: Landscape: Panama is a tropical country with a lot of hills
text: Panama is a tropical country with a lot of hills. You will find a lot of palms and other tropical plants along with drier rolling hills and fields.

clues.title: Landscape: Most roads are paralleled by fences that are partly or…
text: Most roads are paralleled by fences that are partly or fully made out of small trees. The rest of the fence posts are also almost always wooden.

clues.title: Architecture: Panamanian architecture often reflects Spanish colonial…
text: Panamanian architecture often reflects **Spanish colonial influences**, featuring vibrant colours, and some ornate detailing. The most common type of building has **painted concrete** or sometimes brick** **walls with red metal sheets or tiles for a roof. Many** **windows have bars on them for security.

clues.title: Road line: Panama features a diverse set of road lines
text: Panama features a diverse set of road lines, but the most common combination is [solid outer white with an inner yellow line](https://goo.gl/maps/KAGUqGk3zVKLnNXH8). However, those are not unique to Panama. Within Latin America, solid outer white lines with no middle line are almost unique to Panama.

clues.title: Pole: Panama uses a wide variety of poles
text: Panama uses a wide variety of poles, but the most common type is a **round concrete pole**, with a varying amount of insulators. Poles can also be wooden or metallic. They often have [plates](https://goo.gl/maps/5u2MsQ5wAd6cLHTt7) attached to them. [Blue](https://goo.gl/maps/wCUF3vx7iUtNgZjAA), [white](https://goo.gl/maps/4wmrWMk22ZnZtY3x5), or [red](https://goo.gl/maps/4tDyan7Qz2WnrPsX9) numbers are commonly painted on them as well.

clues.title: Plate: Yellow taxis with a chequerboard patterned horizontal…
text: **Yellow **taxis with a **chequerboard patterned horizontal stripe** are a common sight in Panama. The licence plate will be drawn on the side, containing the city name and a [regional code](/panama#taxiplates).

clues.title: Stop sign: Panama uses the Spanish word “ALTO” on stop signs
text: Panama uses the Spanish word “**ALTO**” on stop signs.

NOTE: [Mexico](https://goo.gl/maps/f1zLdwAo5VhYDhtC7), [Costa Rica](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K6pZqyNn2Hw52GXJ7) and [Guatemala](https://www.google.com/maps/@14.6255005,-90.5568668,3a,15y,74.14h,81.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smSi97ivNOrtG5_baoEx9YQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) also use “ALTO”, but the font is thinner.

clues.title: Chevron: Red octagonal signs with an oddly realistic eye are unique…
text: Red octagonal signs with an oddly **realistic eye** are unique to Panama.

clues.title: Coverage: While Panama is quite well covered
text: While Panama is quite well covered, there is barely any coverage on the north coast, or east of Panama City.

clues.title: The first digit of phone numbers can be used to regionguess…
text: The first digit of phone numbers can be used to regionguess Panama.
The numbers with a smaller font indicate potentially useful [regional two-digit codes](https://goo.gl/maps/fgoa9tJUxY5QL2C56).
NOTE: Only phone numbers with 7 digits are helpful, and any numbers starting with 5, 6, or 8 are useless as well.

clues.title: Plate: The first digit of taxi and bus licence plates can be used…
text: The first digit of taxi and bus licence plates can be used to regionguess Panama.
NOTE: Cars travel, so they are not always reliable, especially outside of cities.

clues.title: Landscape: Green tropical landscapes with palm trees and very tall…
text: **Green tropical landscapes** with palm trees and very tall grass** **are common around Colón and Panama City.

clues.title: Landscape: Volcanic rocks that are either scattered on the ground
text: **Volcanic rocks** that are either scattered on the ground, or built into **rock walls**, are common north of David.

clues.title: Landscape: The area around David is very flat
text: The area around David is **very flat**, with lots of fairly **open fields**. Usually, [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/MT8CapwfA7XwFeDw9) will be visible to the north and northeast.

clues.title: Landscape: The region around Aguadulce is relatively flat and features…
text: The region around Aguadulce is relatively **flat **and features a lot of agricultural fields along with very **brown or orange** soil.

clues.title: Pole: The eastern provinces often have tall vertical plates that…
text: The eastern provinces often have tall vertical plates that can be yellow or white. They are commonly attached to poles by black zip ties.

NOTE: Be careful not to mix them up with [these white vertical plates](https://goo.gl/maps/9UssGMTvSrtsLBN98), often attached by metallic zip ties. They are slightly wider than the eastern plates and always have 6 digits.

clues.title: Pole: Many poles in the western provinces will have horizontal…
text: Many poles in the western provinces will have **horizontal **plates attached to them. However, if one of these is accompanied by an [eastern vertical plate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Fd541FefRusFDcE37), the eastern plate takes precedence.

clues.title: Pole: Thin yellow plates, vertical or horizontal, with a visible…
text: Thin yellow plates, vertical or horizontal, with a visible black border are most common in the Colón Province.

clues.title: Wind turbines can be seen south and north of Penonome
text: Wind turbines can be seen [south](https://goo.gl/maps/NFm7beZBXA6frwMb7) and [north](https://goo.gl/maps/tbfJ4v7xXsSbRa4B8) of Penonome.

clues.title: Landscape: The main covered road in the Ngäbe-Buglé province is very…
text: The main covered road in the Ngäbe-Buglé province is very **high-altitude** and almost above the clouds. The surrounding mountains tend to be quite **dry**, and the altitude makes for many stunning views.

clues.title: Landscape: The road going to Changuinola features a lush and green…
text: The road going to Changuinola features a lush and **green hilly landscape**. The weather is **cloudy **or overcast** **on the entire road.

clues.title: Landscape: Highway 9 going from Panama City north to Colón is a…
text: Highway 9 going from Panama City north to Colón is a **divided concrete highway**. The road is visibly **grainy **and has a lot of **tar lines**. The landscape is lush and hilly.

clues.title: Landscape: Most of Road 407 features a freshly paved road
text: Most of Road 407 features a **freshly paved road**, with visibly **orange soil** on the sides of the road. The southern portion is [hilly](https://goo.gl/maps/jAhhHN6t4w56XvCM6), right before the road quality [deteriorates](https://goo.gl/maps/F59mLWj9TrUS9LXM8).

clues.title: Architecture: Panama City can be recognised by the large number of white…
text: Panama City can be recognised by the large number of **white high-rise buildings**.

clues.title: Architecture: Colón features a lot of warehouses and rundown multi-storey…
text: Colón features a lot of **warehouses **and **rundown multi-storey buildings**.

clues.title: Landscape: The region around Changuinola is filled with banana…
text: The region around Changuinola is filled with** banana plantations.**

clues.title: Coverage: Sunset coverage can be found in southern Panama on a small…
text: **Sunset **coverage can be found in southern Panama on a small road south of Tonosi.

clues.title: Landscape: A mountainous landscape with pine trees
text: A mountainous** **landscape with **pine trees**, **volcanic rocks**, **dry grass**, and gravel roads can be found northeast of Volcán.

clues.title: Pole: Yellow pole socks can be found near the Panama Canal
text: **Yellow pole socks** can be found near the Panama Canal, around the town of Gatún.

clues.title: Stop sign: Alto
text: Panama, Guatemala, Costa Rica and Mexico are the only countries using the word "Alto" on their stop signs.
